content.short: GhostMarket is a non-custodial, cross-chain NFT marketplace powered by smart contracts.
content.description: GhostMarket is a fully non-custodial, cross-chain NFT marketplace powered by smart contracts on multiple blockchains. Its self-minting platform lets artists and developers create NFTs while controlling royalties, attributes, and locked content. It also provides a developer SDK with extensive documentation for easy integration. Users can buy and swap crypto and stake GM through GFUND's single-token staking system. Designed for builders and collectors alike, GhostMarket scales across chains with a robust developer ecosystem.
